授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: This class continues where Linear Algebra I finishes. See the syllabus of Linear Algebra I for details on first class etc.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: This course aims to provide students with a solid foundation in linear algebra, focusing on the core concepts of vectors, matrices, systems of linear equations, vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors. The goal is to develop students’ analytical and problem-solving skills, enabling them to model, analyze, and solve a wide range of real world problems using linear algebra techniques. By the end of the course, students should understand linear algebra as a coherent system of ideas in which meaning, correctness, and usefulness arise from structure, definitions, and reasoning rather than from formulas or authority.
